records.name: Cranaleith Spiritual Center
records.summary: Volunteers help care for the ten acre grounds of a spiritual center in Northeast Philadelphia, from the vegetable garden and bees to the labyrinth and visitor welcome.
records.what_you_do: Work the vegetable garden, adopt a garden or tree, help bottle honey, do lawn and grounds work, greet visitors, decorate for holidays, or help at events.

first_step.how: Use the Join Our Team button on the volunteer page to send the volunteer form, or call or email the center
first_step.basis: The volunteer page welcomes individuals and groups of all ages and skill levels and gives a clear sign-up form, but it does not describe orientation or a set schedule

records.notes: Found through an Idealist listing (platform used as a lead only). Facts come from the center's own volunteer page. The page lists volunteer areas, with newsletters dated July 2024, September 2024 and February 2025 as the newest dated items. The own site does not say whether roles are one time or ongoing, so commitment is set to ongoing_role from the site's standing volunteer team wording only; treat it as unconfirmed and check with the center.

records.name: Action Wellness Buddy Program
records.summary: Trained volunteers called buddies offer friendship, emotional support and some help with everyday tasks to people living with HIV, matched one to one with a client.
records.what_you_do: Visit or call a matched client on a regular basis, offer companionship, and help with small daily tasks. Buddies take part in monthly support meetings with other buddies.

first_step.how: Complete the volunteer application linked as Apply Now on the site, then attend a volunteer orientation
first_step.basis: A public application and orientation come before any match, so the way in is clear but not drop in

records.notes: Found through an Idealist listing (platform used as a lead only). The group's own buddy page lists a virtual volunteer orientation on October 7, 2026, which is the newest dated item. The site does not state the minimum age, time commitment or background check on the pages read, so min_age 18 is not confirmed from the own site and should be checked before launch. Commitment is set to ongoing_role because buddies are matched with a client for a continuing relationship; the length is not stated on the site.

records.name: Ignatian Volunteer Corps, Philadelphia and South Jersey
records.summary: Adults 50 and older give one or two days a week, September through June, to Philadelphia nonprofits that serve people in need, with monthly reflection gatherings.
records.what_you_do: Serve on site with a partner nonprofit in areas such as housing, food, tutoring, support for immigrants, and elder care, and join monthly reflection sessions with other volunteers.

schedule.text: One or two days a week, usually September through June

first_step.how: Submit the interest form on the IVC contact page, or email the regional director, then go through a conversation to find a match
first_step.basis: An interest form, a conversation and a match come before serving, so the way in takes several steps

records.notes: Found through an Idealist listing (platform used as a lead only). Faith label catholic is an inference from the Ignatian (Jesuit) program and its spiritual reflection component; the page says the program includes spiritual reflection but the faith field is not stated as a requirement, so verify before launch. Status active rests only on the newest image upload folder dated May 2026, not on a dated news item, so confidence is low. The regional office street address was not found on the page, so no location is listed.

leads_only.name: New Leash on Life USA (vet tech volunteer)
leads_only.note: Listed on Idealist (platform, lead only). Role is for experienced vet techs on call, a narrow skill-based role. Own website not found within the search budget, so not checked. Found through Idealist.

leads_only.name: Harmonious Volunteer Center
leads_only.note: Named on an Idealist organization page and a search result. Own site returned HTTP 403, so it is listed under blocked and not published. Newest local coverage found is from 2015, so current status is unknown.

leads_only.name: Red Cross Southeastern Pennsylvania, Blood Donor Ambassador and Write On! remote newsletter volunteer
leads_only.note: Listed on Idealist (platform, lead only). The Red Cross volunteer page returned HTTP 403, so the roles could not be verified from the group's own site and nothing was published. Retry only by a different route approved by the owner.

leads_only.name: Project Sunshine (Philadelphia Here to Play listing)
leads_only.note: National program. The own page was read and describes the role in general terms; Philadelphia facility details, minimum age and time commitment were only on platform listings, so nothing was published. Found through Idealist.

blocked.note: Bot check or 403 on the Red Cross volunteer page; not retried.
403 on the group's own site; not retried.

Idealist listing page loaded but showed no readable results to the fetch tool (results appear to be rendered by script). Used search results for names and links instead, and read no further Idealist pages.

notes: Platform budget: one Idealist page read (the listing page), well under the 12 page cap. Idealist names and links came from search results, and no Idealist page was used as a source for any fact. Join Philly was not used in this run. Search budget: all 8 WebSearch calls used (cap reached). Fetch budget: 11 fetches used. Dropped without a record: The Philadelphia Project (thephillyproject.org), which is an Idealist lead with its own site. Its own pages describe church and youth group service trips, Summer of Service, and mailing or meal help for groups; it does not describe a recurring role an individual can join, and its newest dated item is from 2022, so it was not published. Its 2022 reference is also too old to show it is active. Worth re-checking if the owner wants group service trips listed. Other Idealist results seen but not checked for lack of budget: Cranaleith and Action Wellness were the strongest; the 'Garden and Grounds Care' and 'General Volunteer' listings are the same organization as Cranaleith and were merged into one record. Idealist listing for Ignatian Volunteer Corps was merged into the one IVC record.
